hero.label: Smart Fundis / 01 — Proof of skill
hero.body: Your work, your reputation. Prove your skill with one short phone video. AI checks every step. A human Expert decides. You earn a badge clients can trust.
hero.imageAlt: Hands terminating copper wires in a socket box with a screwdriver

record.label: 02 — Record
record.title: Record your work.
record.body: Write your code on paper, show it to the camera, then do the job in one continuous shot. A fresh code every time, so the video is really yours, really now.

check.label: 03 — Check
check.title: AI checks each step.
check.body: NVIDIA AI watches every step of the task and marks exactly where it happens in your video.
check.safety: Safety steps are never passed automatically.

decide.label: 04 — Decide
decide.title: An Expert decides.
decide.caption: A safety step marked unclear caps the AI at 'needs review'. AI recommends. Experts decide.

badge.label: 05 — Badge
badge.title: Your work, your badge.
badge.body: Your video stays private. Only your badge is public, on a profile you can share with any client.

scope.label: 07 — Scope

scope.body: What 'Verified by Smart Fundis' means, and what it doesn't.

checks.expert: An Expert in your trade decides

scope.certify: NITA, KNQA and TVETs certify qualifications. We verify a skill, on video.

rules.body: A safety step marked no or unclear, or a code that doesn't match, caps the result at Needs review.

expert.title: Expert
expert.body: A human Expert approves, rejects or asks for a reshoot.
